description: This file provides database utility functions for a mobile service booking backend, including schema initialization, data seeding, CRUD operations, and utility functions for interacting with a Supabase database.

methods.name: str _table(name: str)
methods.description: Utility to construct the full table name, including schema if specified.

methods.name: Any _sb()
methods.description: Shorthand to access cached Supabase client instance.

methods.name: Any _sb_exec(query)
methods.description: Executes a Supabase query, normalizes and returns the data, or raises if error occurs.

methods.name: None _ensure_catalog_seeded()
methods.description: Seeds the catalog data (brands, models, services) into the database if not already present.

methods.name: None init_schema()
methods.description: Initializes the database schema, attempting to seed catalog data if Supabase is configured.

methods.name: list[dict] list_services()
methods.description: Returns a list of available repair services from the database.

methods.name: list[dict] list_booking_services()
methods.description: Returns a list of repair service options used in the booking UI.

methods.name: list[dict] list_brands()
methods.description: Returns available device brands for the booking flow.

methods.name: list[dict] list_models_for_brand(brand: str)
methods.description: Returns available models for a specified device brand.

methods.name: dict get_site_content(keys: list[str])
methods.description: Fetches key-value pairs for site content based on provided keys.

methods.name: int create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)
methods.description: Inserts a new customer request and returns its ID.

methods.name: int create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str)
methods.description: Creates a new booking record and returns its ID.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_device_selection( booking_id: int, brand: str | None, model: str | None, service: str | None )
methods.description: Updates the device and service selections for a specific booking.

methods.name: list[dict] list_bookings(limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent bookings, with a specified limit.

methods.name: dict|None get_booking_by_id(booking_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a booking by its ID.

methods.name: dict|None get_latest_booking_by_phone(phone: str)
methods.description: Fetches the most recent booking for a given phone number.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_status(booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
methods.description: Updates the status and notes of a booking and returns the updated record.

methods.name: bool verify_admin_credentials(username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies admin user credentials against environment variables.

methods.name: bool is_pincode_serviceable(pincode: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a given pincode is within the serviceable area.

ctags.name: create_booking
ctags.pattern: /^def create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str) -> int:$/

ctags.name: create_customer_request
ctags.pattern: /^def create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str) /
ctags.signature: (name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)

ctags.name: update_booking_device_selection
ctags.signature: ( booking_id: int, brand: str | None, model: str | None, service: str | None )

ctags.name: update_booking_status
ctags.pattern: /^def update_booking_status(booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None) -> dict | None/
ctags.signature: (booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
